layout.app/cart/: handler.go, handler_add_item.go, handler_update_item.go, handler_remove_item.go, handler_read.go, handler_clear_on_checkout.go, service.go, repository.go, model.go, enricher.go

tables.name: carts
tables.notes: One cart per customer enforced at DB level via UNIQUE(user_id). cart_id is UUIDv7.

tables.name: cart_items
tables.notes: UNIQUE(cart_id, product_id) enforces one-line-per-SKU invariant (CART-006). qty CHECK (qty > 0). No price column — price fetched live.

tables.name: cart_clear_idempotency
tables.notes: Idempotency anchor for cart.clear-on-checkout keyed on orderId (CHK-010). INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. No TTL in MVP; prune job deferred.

endpoints.name: add-item

productId.description: UUID of the product to add

subtotal.description: THB minor units; checkoutable lines only

validation_rules: productId: non-empty string, valid UUID format — common/validator uuid4 tag
qty: integer >= 1 — common/validator min=1 tag; qty=0 or negative → VALIDATION_ERROR

error_contract.trigger: Missing or invalid Authorization: Bearer JWT
JWT signature / exp / iss / aud check failed
productId empty/invalid UUID or qty < 1
catalog.product.detail returns NOT_FOUND for productId
product.status == INACTIVE — cannot add to cart
product.status == DELETED — cannot add to cart
catalog.product.detail call exceeds deadline or returns network error
Unexpected DB error or pgx panic

edge_behavior.idempotency: Same-SKU merge via INSERT … ON CONFLICT (cart_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET qty = cart_items.qty + EXCLUDED.qty in a single pgx transaction. Two concurrent add-item calls for the same SKU serialize on the UNIQUE row lock; final qty = sum of both. No phantom rows, no TOCTOU race. (CART-006)
side_effects: UPSERT into cart.carts (get-or-create cart for user_id)
INSERT INTO cart.cart_items … ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (merge qty)
edge_behavior.transactionality: Single pgx BEGIN/COMMIT spanning the cart UPSERT, item merge INSERT, and updated_at touch

implementation_hints: Use common/wrapper.BindJSON[AddItemRequest] for request binding — returns 400 automatically on malformed body
Use common/token.ClaimsFromContext(ctx) to extract claims.Sub as userID
Call common/httpclient.Post for catalog.product.detail; wrap deadline error as UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT via common/serror
Use common/database pgx pool for the transaction; no raw SQL string concatenation
Use common/generator.NewUUIDv7() for new cart_id and cart_item id
Return enriched cart via internal ReadCart logic (re-use CartService.ReadCart) after the write
No inventory call on this path — INV-002 prohibits reservation at add-time

endpoints.name: update-item

qty.description: qty=0 triggers remove; qty<0 is VALIDATION_ERROR

validation_rules: cartItemId: non-empty string, valid UUID format — common/validator uuid4 tag
qty: integer >= 0 — qty < 0 → VALIDATION_ERROR; qty = 0 → delete path; qty >= 1 → update path
Ownership check: cartItemId must belong to the cart whose user_id == claims.Sub → NOT_FOUND on mismatch (no cross-user leakage)

error_contract.trigger: Missing or invalid JWT
JWT validation failed
cartItemId invalid UUID, qty < 0, or qty > availableQty (CART-002 — includes availableQty in error detail)
No cart for user, or cartItemId not in this user's cart
inventory.stock.bulk-read call exceeds deadline (qty > 0 path only)
Unexpected DB error

edge_behavior.idempotency: Last-writer-wins on qty. No idempotency key required. Concurrent updates for the same cartItemId serialize on the pgx row lock.
side_effects: qty == 0: DELETE FROM cart.cart_items WHERE id=$1 AND cart_id=$2
qty >= 1: UPDATE cart.cart_items SET qty=$1 WHERE id=$2 AND cart_id=$3
edge_behavior.transactionality: Single pgx transaction for the DELETE or UPDATE + updated_at touch. Stock check (inventory.stock.bulk-read) runs BEFORE the transaction — it is a best-effort UX guard, not a reservation.

implementation_hints: qty=0 branches into the same internal logic as remove-item (CartService.removeItemInternal); do not duplicate the delete path

Stock check via common/httpclient.Post to inventory.stock.bulk-read with [productId]; extract availableQty from response; compare with requested qty; return VALIDATION_ERROR with {availableQty} detail if exceeded
Ownership check: SELECT cart_id FROM cart.carts WHERE user_id=$1 THEN verify cartItemId in that cart — use parameterized query, no string concat
Use common/serror.Wrap for structured error chain on upstream failures

endpoints.name: remove-item
validation_rules: cartItemId: non-empty string, valid UUID format — common/validator uuid4 tag
Ownership implicit: DELETE WHERE id=$1 AND cart_id=$2; 0 rows affected = idempotent no-op (STORY_CART_REMOVE edge case: already-removed line returns 200 with current cart)

error_contract.trigger: Missing or invalid JWT
JWT validation failed
cartItemId empty or invalid UUID format
Unexpected DB error

edge_behavior.idempotency: Idempotent — DELETE WHERE id=$1 AND cart_id=$2; if 0 rows affected the item was already removed; return current cart state with 200 SUCCESS. No error surfaced for already-removed lines.
side_effects: DELETE FROM cart.cart_items WHERE id=$1 AND cart_id=$2 (0 rows = no-op)
UPDATE cart.carts SET updated_at = now() (always — even on no-op, to advance the staleness marker)
edge_behavior.transactionality: Single pgx transaction for DELETE + updated_at touch.

implementation_hints: Get cart_id from carts WHERE user_id=$1 — if no cart exists, return empty cart (idempotent; nothing to remove)
Use pgx RowsAffected() to distinguish deletion vs no-op; both paths return 200
Return enriched cart after delete via CartService.ReadCart — this recomputes subtotal from remaining items (CART-004, CART-003)
INACTIVE/DELETED product lines can always be removed (STORY_CART_REMOVE AC #2 — no catalog check on remove path)

endpoints.name: read

request_schema.description: Empty body — userId derived from JWT claims.Sub

available.description: false if productStatus != ACTIVE OR availableQty == 0; never silent — always has unavailReason when false

subtotal.description: Sum of lineSubtotal for checkoutable=true lines only (CART-004)

validation_rules: No request fields to validate — body is empty; userId from JWT claims only
MAX_CART_ITEMS=50 enforced before fan-out: if DB returns > 50 items, trim to first 50 and log warning

error_contract.trigger: Missing or invalid JWT
JWT validation failed
Any single catalog.product.detail call OR the inventory.stock.bulk-read call exceeds the 3000ms fan-out deadline or returns a network error. Strict: no partial success — the entire read fails.
Unexpected DB error on cart/cart_items fetch

edge_behavior.idempotency: Read — trivially idempotent. No state mutation.
edge_behavior.transactionality: No DB transaction — read-only SELECT. Fan-out is stateless.

fan_out_spec.inventory_call: inventory.stock.bulk-read for all productIds in one batch call (single goroutine)
fan_out_spec.error_policy: strict — first upstream error from any goroutine cancels all in-flight via errgroup context and surfaces UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT
fan_out_spec.available_flag: cart.read returns line-item available:bool flag with unavailReason; never silent fall-through (calibration requirement)
fan_out_spec.subtotal_rule: checkoutable=true lines only; INACTIVE/DELETED/OUT_OF_STOCK lines excluded from subtotal

implementation_hints: Use golang.org/x/sync/errgroup.WithContext(fanoutCtx) — both catalog and inventory goroutines run inside the same errgroup
Semaphore: buffered channel chan struct{} with capacity=10; acquire before catalog call, release in defer
Pre-allocate catalogResults []CatalogDetail with len(items) slots; write by index (not map) to avoid concurrent map-write race
stockByProductID map written by a single goroutine (the inventory goroutine) — no race
Outer timeout context: context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second); pass gCtx (from errgroup) to all downstream HTTP calls so cancellation propagates
common/httpclient.Post for both catalog and inventory calls; wrap context.DeadlineExceeded as UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT via common/serror
Empty cart (no rows in cart_items OR no cart row at all): return {items:[], subtotal:0, updatedAt: zero-or-cart.updatedAt} with 200 SUCCESS — no fan-out
All prices as int64 minor units — never float64 (cross-cutting.pricing.currency rule)

endpoints.name: clear-on-checkout

customerUserId.description: Must equal JWT claims.Sub — no cross-user leakage

cartItemIds.description: IDs of cart_items to remove; only these rows deleted

orderId.description: Idempotency anchor; replay returns cached removed count

removed.description: Count of rows deleted; 0 is valid on replay or if cartItemIds already removed

validation_rules: customerUserId: non-empty UUID AND must equal JWT claims.Sub — VALIDATION_ERROR on mismatch (prevents cross-customer cart manipulation)
cartItemIds: non-empty array; each element valid UUID format

error_contract.trigger: Missing or invalid JWT
JWT validation failed
customerUserId != claims.Sub, or cartItemIds empty, or orderId empty/invalid UUID
Unexpected DB error

edge_behavior.idempotency: Idempotent on orderId. On first call: execute DELETE and persist {order_id, removed} in cart_clear_idempotency. On replay: SELECT removed FROM cart_clear_idempotency WHERE order_id=$1; if found, return cached removed count immediately without re-executing DELETE. Uses INSERT INTO cart_clear_idempotency ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING after the DELETE.
side_effects: DELETE FROM cart.cart_items WHERE cart_id=$1 AND id=ANY($2::uuid[]) — pgx array param, no string concat
INSERT INTO cart.cart_clear_idempotency (order_id, removed, created_at) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
edge_behavior.transactionality: Single pgx BEGIN/COMMIT: DELETE cart_items + UPDATE carts.updated_at + INSERT cart_clear_idempotency. Idempotency check (SELECT) runs before the transaction; the INSERT ensures the record is committed atomically with the DELETE.
edge_behavior.internal_note: Caller (checkout service) forwards the customer's own Bearer JWT (AMB-002 resolution). This endpoint validates customerUserId == claims.Sub as the cross-customer leakage guard. Leftover cart items not in cartItemIds are untouched (CHK-010).

implementation_hints: Idempotency check first: SELECT removed FROM cart.cart_clear_idempotency WHERE order_id=$1 — if row exists, return {removed: N} immediately
DELETE uses pgx array parameter: DELETE FROM cart.cart_items WHERE cart_id=$1 AND id=ANY($2::uuid[]) — never build the IN clause via string formatting
Capture pgxResult.RowsAffected() as removed count
Wrap DELETE + updated_at touch + idempotency INSERT in a single pgx transaction
customerUserId == claims.Sub check happens BEFORE any DB operation — fail fast on mismatch with VALIDATION_ERROR
Use common/logger slog.Error if DELETE fails mid-transaction; rollback and return INTERNAL_ERROR

test_strategy.unit: Table-driven tests per handler using mockery-generated mocks for CartService interface and downstream clients (CatalogClient, InventoryClient). pgxmock for repository-level tests. All happy + negative paths covered with t.Run sub-tests.
test_strategy.integration: testcontainers-go spinning a real Postgres 15 container for repository tests. Docker-compose smoke: register user → add item → update → read → remove. CART-006 concurrency test: 10 goroutines all add qty=1 for the same productId; assert exactly one cart_items row with qty=10.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Authenticated Customer adds an active product with qty > 0 to cart.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: catalog.product.detail verifies ACTIVE status before write. JWT middleware enforces CUSTOMER role. qty >= 1 validated by request schema.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Adding same SKU twice merges into one line with summed qty.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: INSERT INTO cart_items … ON CONFLICT (cart_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET qty = cart_items.qty + EXCLUDED.qty in single pgx tx. UNIQUE(cart_id, product_id) constraint enforces invariant.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Cart update qty must not exceed current availableQty.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: inventory.stock.bulk-read called on update path (qty>=1 branch). qty > availableQty → VALIDATION_ERROR with availableQty in detail. No reservation created — stock check only (INV-002).

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Customer removes a cart item via qty=0 on update.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: qty=0 branches into internal removeItemInternal logic (DELETE + updated_at). Subtotal recomputed on enriched cart return.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Customer removes a cart line; subtotal updates accordingly.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE id=$1 AND cart_id=$2. Return enriched cart with recomputed subtotal (CART-004). Remove works for INACTIVE/DELETED product lines — no catalog check on remove path.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Cart subtotal computed server-side from current product price.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: currentPrice fetched live from catalog.product.detail per item at read-time. subtotal = sum(currentPrice*qty) for checkoutable=true lines only. Never trusts client-computed value.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Cart flags items whose product became INACTIVE/DELETED as non-checkoutable.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: catalog.product.detail called per item at read-time. status != ACTIVE → checkoutable=false, available=false, unavailReason set. Checkout rejects these lines (CHK-003). Line never silently dropped from response.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: Cart row carries updatedAt for stale-cart detection.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: carts.updated_at updated on every add/update/remove mutation. Returned as updatedAt (RFC3339) in cart.read response.

ba_acceptance_mapping.description: After checkout, only ordered items removed from cart; leftover items remain.
ba_acceptance_mapping.implementation_notes: Checkout supplies exact cartItemIds. DELETE WHERE id=ANY($2::uuid[]) removes only specified rows. Idempotent on orderId via cart_clear_idempotency table.

contract_ambiguities.issue: Contract does not specify whether add-item should call inventory for a stock check. INV-002 says no reservation at add-time; BA CART-002 scopes the check to 'update'. Resolution: NO inventory call on add-item path.
contract_ambiguities.resolution: No inventory call on add-item. Stock check only on update-item path (UX guard) and at checkout.commit (authoritative reservation). Documented in implementation_hints.

contract_ambiguities.issue: MVP has no SERVICE role JWT. Checkout calls this endpoint using the customer's own access token forwarded from checkout.commit.
contract_ambiguities.resolution: Checkout forwards the customer's Bearer token. cart.clear-on-checkout validates customerUserId == claims.Sub for cross-customer leakage prevention.

contract_ambiguities.issue: Calibration says 'never silent fall-through' and 'available:bool flag with reason'. This could mean per-line degradation OR strict whole-read failure. The contract's failure_modes list only AUTH_MISSING; UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT is in the cross-cutting registry.
contract_ambiguities.resolution: Strict policy: any upstream failure (catalog OR inventory) → UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT on the whole read. Per-line degradation (mark line unavailable but return 200) would require a contract amendment. Surfaced here so orchestrator can confirm.

contract_ambiguities.issue: Contract request shows qty: int (>=1) but CART-003 and STORY_CART_UPDATE_QTY edge case say qty=0 should trigger remove. BA leaves choice to Tech-Designer.
contract_ambiguities.resolution: Accept qty >= 0 at handler; qty=0 triggers internal remove logic; qty < 0 → VALIDATION_ERROR. Documented in validation_rules and request_schema (minimum: 0).
